Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for activity records in assay CHEMBL1613836. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join activities to compound_structures and molecule_dictionary. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
